(3) A man wearing a golden crown and a red cape with fur trim stands by a window, holding a King of Spades card and gesturing as if giving a command. (4) The scene shifts outdoors to a green grassy field under a bright, overcast sky where several people dressed in full-body black suits with snail-like headgear are running and yelling toward the camera. (5) The blonde-haired man and another man in a striped shirt are now in the park, holding wooden bows and arrows; they look upward and talk with frustrated facial expressions. (6) A man in a grey t-shirt with a long brown wig and glasses appears, holding a small metal sword and looking confused. (7) Graphical overlays resembling a mobile game interface appear, showing damage numbers like '-100' and '-999' as characters engage in stylized combat with glowing light effects. (8) The video concludes with a full-screen animation displaying game characters, a logo, and promotional rewards like 'Lucky 777' on a bright purple and white background.
